columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: Reference to the recommendation summary row.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_NUMBER
columns.description: System generated unique identifier for the recommendation.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Specifies the status for the recommendation.

columns.name: STATUS_SCOPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the status scope used to derive the recommendation status.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_CATEGORY
columns.description: Specifies the category for the recommendation.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_RANK
columns.description: Specifies the order of the recommendation in a given recommendation category.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_SCORE
columns.description: Specifies the score for the recommendation in a given recommendation category.

columns.name: RECOMMENDED_ON_DATE
columns.description: Specifies the date recommendation is effective.

columns.name: WITHDRAWN_DATE
columns.description: Specifies the date recommendation is withdrawn.

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the reason for withdrawing the recommendation.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the assigner of the recommendation.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTION_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the persona used to create the recommendation.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTION_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the attribution type for the assigner of the recommendation.

columns.name: STATUS_CHANGE_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the type of status change for the recommendation.

columns.name: STATUS_CHANGE_COMMENT
columns.description: Comments to be captured during the status change.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RELATION_ID
columns.description: Represents the Relation Id of the recommendation profile.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Represents the recommendation profile id

columns.name: ESS_JOB_ID
columns.description: Represents ESS job id that created or modified the recommendation.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_COMMENTS
columns.description: Represnets the comments for recoomendation.
